archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Adapted for Industrial Professional Theme)

brand.name: IIP - Indian Industrial Products
brand.logo_concept: Gear with India map and machinery elements
brand.vibe: Clean, modern, startup-style interface. Inspired by Facebook + Instagram + B2B marketplace.

primary.description: Industrial Deep Blue for trust, headers, and primary active states.

secondary.description: Safety Orange for CTAs, Enquiry buttons, and highlight badges.

accent.description: Machinery Steel Grey for secondary text, borders, and passive icons.

background.description: Light slate background to let white cards stand out.

surface.description: Pure white for cards, dropdowns, and modules.

headings.usage: Bold and clean for company names, headers, and numbers.

body.usage: Highly legible for dense industrial specs, descriptions, and UI text.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Mobile-first, card-based social feed. Generous padding inside cards, tight gaps between modules.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: p-4 for standard cards, p-6 for feature sections, gap-4 for feed items.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-xl for cards, rounded-full for buttons and avatars
layout_and_spacing.shadows: shadow-sm for inactive cards, shadow-md hover:shadow-lg for interactive elements (soft shadows).
layout_and_spacing.navigation: Fixed bottom tab bar for mobile (Home, Reels, Enquiry, Leads, Profile) with glassmorphism backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 border-t border-slate-200.

components.cards: bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden. Use for feed posts and product listings.

buttons.primary: bg-orange-600 text-white rounded-full px-6 py-2 font-medium hover:bg-orange-700 transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-blue-50 text-blue-800 rounded-full px-4 py-2 font-medium hover:bg-blue-100 transition-colors
buttons.whatsapp: bg-[#25D366] text-white rounded-full px-4 py-2 font-medium flex items-center gap-2 hover:bg-[#20bd5a]

components.badges: px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium rounded-md. Example: bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 for 'New Lead'.
components.social_actions: flex justify-between items-center py-3 border-t border-slate-100 mt-3 text-slate-500 text-sm

media.strategy: High-quality industrial imagery. Do not use generic placeholders.

images.description: Factory workers overlay for featured companies slider
Heavy machinery operation vertical crop for Reels thumbnail
Illuminated logo for company profile avatar

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the mobile-first approach. Ensure max-w-md container for mobile feed layout, with bottom navigation visible on mobile viewports.
Use 'Outfit' for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text. Do not use generic fonts like Inter for headings.
For the Social Feed: Use Facebook/Instagram style cards. Header with avatar/name/location. Image/Video content. Footer with Like/Comment/Share/WhatsApp/Enquiry buttons.
For Reels: Full height vertical layout (h-[calc(100vh-bottom_nav_height)]) with absolute positioned right-side action buttons (Like, Comment, Share, WhatsApp).
All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs) MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='enquiry-submit-button').
Use Lucide-React for all icons (MessageCircle, Heart, Share2, MapPin, Briefcase, Play, etc).
Do NOT use transparent headers. Use glassmorphism (`bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md`) for sticky elements.
For the Leads Dashboard: Use status pills (New, In Progress, Closed) and clear, dense cards for B2B tracking.
Replace ALL placeholders with the provided high-quality Unsplash image URLs.
Ensure hover states and focus states have visible contrast changes.
Follow Shadcn conventions but customize spacing and radiuses according to layout_and_spacing rules.
